items.title: Track ty exception-suppressing context-manager semantics as forecast analyzer evidence
items.summary: Astral ty changed reachability/type semantics for synchronous and asynchronous context managers that may suppress exceptions. The profile binds these paths to ty analyzer nodes and then to the static/dynamic correlation node; CPython and local probes remain authoritative for runtime/compiler behavior.
items.localContractImpact: No installed-baseline or qualification-contract update is admitted in this run. Keep the change as forecast evidence for future Astral/CPython correlation because fatb4f/ctrl@main and its lock state did not change.
